انتشلن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَشَلْنَ (intašalna) /in.ta.ʃal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَشَلَ (intašala)
# اُنْتُشِلْنَ (untušilna) /un.tu.ʃil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَشَلَ (intašala)
# اِنْتَشِلْنَ (intašilna) /in.ta.ʃil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْتَشَلَ (intašala)
